reference.name: Komorebi Physics: Continuum, Geometry and Refinement
reference.reference_assembly: 18 source-retypeset LaTeX components, then vector-page assembly with global navigation

typography.source_sans: Nimbus Sans explicit OpenType files, .94 scale
typography.source_math: Latin Modern Math; explicit bold math via symbf
typography.caption: small sans, hanging label, muted text, ragged right

recommended_core_palette.description: Deep plum, mulberry and restrained old gold. White reading pages. Primary and accent are for dark text on white; gold is a short decorative rule, not small text.

layout_system.cover: Full primary-color typographic cover, large serif title, small tracked sans series label, short accent rule, author and year below a restrained bottom rule. No decorative figure claimed as science.
layout_system.frontmatter: Formal title, scope, introduction, reading conventions, linked contents. One unnumbered cover; Roman preliminary folios.
layout_system.parts: White pages with tracked part label, large serif title, short rule, accurate scope paragraph, local linked list of treatments and global start folios.
layout_system.body: Continuous Arabic folios, mirrored furniture, quiet running headers linked back to contents. Opening pages omit running header but retain folio.
layout_system.theorems: Restrained ordinary theorem presentation, not decorative boxes. Existing mathematical numbering remains local to named treatment.
layout_system.callouts: Optional pale panels, .8 pt accent left edge, no enclosing border, only for genuine reading guidance already supported by content.
layout_system.links: Build complete source-page map before reconstructing internal, named and companion links. Preserve original destination coordinates after page transformations. Scope source bookmarks to selected source-page subset.

adaptation_recommendation.initial_build: Collected reading edition: consistent outer cover, front matter, twelve part leaves, navigation and folios around preserved source vector pages. Preserve mathematical statements, figure data, local numbering and per-paper boundaries.
adaptation_recommendation.full_typographic_match: Requires actual editable source inventory, coordinated LaTeX style adaptation and fresh source builds. Physics achieves this and a PDF assembly alone does not.
adaptation_recommendation.critical_label: Do not call inherited interior pages newly typeset at a uniform 11 pt or claim source rebuild unless performed.
adaptation_recommendation.mixed_pages: Inspect source page sizes, rotation and text bounds. Avoid forcing a landscape or large page into portrait with illegible scaling. Avoid overlaying a new header/folio onto inherited content. Retain source pages and use safe additive margins if blank margins cannot be established.
adaptation_recommendation.source_retention: Keep frozen source-reader bytes in the source package with hashes. New assembled PDF necessarily has different container bytes. Preserve all unique components and document any duplicate exclusions.
adaptation_recommendation.publication_scopes: Carry accepted claims, open conjectures, conditional arithmetic input requirements and inherited proof/replay limits into neutral editorial scope text.

rebuild_requirements.font_path: Explicit installed font filenames prevent incorrect bold-face substitutions; no need to distribute standalone font binaries.
rebuild_requirements.portability: Matching installed TeX/font environment matters; no cross-platform byte-identity promise.

quality_gates: Authenticate latest reference PDF against package copy.
Check selected frozen reader inventories and distinct page units.
Keep all scientific figure bytes and source expressions unchanged if doing source adaptation.
Check no unresolved internal/bookmark/companion destination after global mapping.
Render every final page and inspect all contact sheets plus dense equations, tables, code and openings in detail.
Check extracted-text bounds and no blank or replacement-character pages.
If rebuilding sources, inspect final logs for overfull boxes, undefined references, missing glyphs and font substitutions.
State assembly versus source-rebuild limits accurately.
Preserve font and third-party notices; typography is not relicensing.
